name: EOSE Bootstrap Fixer

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eose/execute-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  fix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Patch bootstrap and remove fixer
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('.github/workflows/eose-execute-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml')
          text=p.read_text()
          old="c=json.load(open('/tmp/exec-contract.json'))"
          new="raw=open('/tmp/exec-contract.json').read().lstrip(); c=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)[0]"
          assert old in text
          text=text.replace(old,new,1)
          old="p=Path('$WT/crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs')"
          new="p=Path(os.environ['WT']) / 'crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs'"
          assert old in text
          text=text.replace(old,new,1)
          old="from pathlib import Path\n          p=Path(os.environ['WT']) / 'crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs'"
          new="from pathlib import Path\n          import os\n          p=Path(os.environ['WT']) / 'crates/monad-core/src/lib.rs'"
          assert old in text
          text=text.replace(old,new,1)
          p.write_text(text)
          Path('.github/workflows/eose-bootstrap-fixer.yml').unlink()
          PY
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(eose): fix execution bootstrap plumbing'
          git push origin HEAD:eose/execute-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap
